# Guardian

> Guardian is a tactical-grid collectible card game by Orsonius, in development since 2010. It fuses grid tactics in the style of Fire Emblem and Final Fantasy Tactics with Magic: The Gathering-style card play. Two players each defend a Guardian on a 5 x 6 board; Summons move, attack and hold positions while Spells, Traps, Items and Workers shape the fight. It exists as a paper game and as a free digital client (alpha) for online play, games against the computer, Draft, tournaments and a story campaign.

This site is the official home of the game: the full card database, the rules wiki, starter decks, the world's lore and news. The rules wiki is the current rule reference.

## Start here

- [Learn to Play](https://guardiancg.netlify.app/learn/): how a game works in four steps, the Quick Start guide and a starter deck to pick
- [Rules wiki](https://guardiancg.netlify.app/wiki/): the complete rules, from setup and turn structure to combat, movement, the Stack and every keyword
- [Play Guardian](https://guardiancg.netlify.app/play/): the digital client, download on itch.io, current version and patch notes
